successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Damagaram in the mid-19th century: 'about 70,000 km2' (European travellers' estimate on the page), a 150 km disc round Zinder (area 70,700 km2), cut to Niger

ledger.x: The 1830s: the Myrria kingdom and the Sassebaki sultanates fall.

wars.name: Conquest of Myrria and the Sassebaki sultanates
wars.outcome: In the 1830s Damagaram conquered the Myrria kingdom and the Sassebaki sultanates, including Zinder.

wars.name: French conquest of Damagaram
wars.outcome: 30 July 1899: the French-led troops of the Voulet-Chanoine mission beat the sultan at the Battle of Tirmini, 10 km from Zinder, and took the capital.

certainty.note: The 70,000 km2 figure is a mid-19th-century traveller's estimate; the disc is a stand-in for the area, not the outline.
